scope.read: two design documents only; previously reviewed frozen N4 interfaces

required_implementation_counterexamples.counterexample: A validation retry remains raw budget_bucket=recovery. A budget exemption based only on that bucket either withholds its own phase reservation incorrectly or permits the wrong protected reservation.
required_implementation_counterexamples.requirement: Derive the excluded protected-hour reservation only from the verified exact original-cell/phase capability, bound frozen recovery identity and parent; preserve raw recovery counters and costs. Validation must retain formal 10h protection.

required_implementation_counterexamples.counterexample: All 60 validation cells are valid and accepted but N4 is below 10/20 or below a same-round control. Completion alone cannot release unused validation hours or admit formal.
required_implementation_counterexamples.requirement: Recompute the complete numeric/control/correctness/native/source/accounting gates; require settled costs and a separate completion-bound explicit release event. Keep original 60/40 slots and all charges.

required_implementation_counterexamples.counterexample: A seed disappears from the private owner ledger after historical shared records are partitioned; an own-ledger-only check falsely declares it unexposed.
required_implementation_counterexamples.requirement: Bind the approved historical exposure metadata and original registries with their stated scope, then recheck own reserved identities at admission. Shared row0 remains declared layout reuse. No automatic seed replacement.

reviewed_design_properties: First-three correctness is not full Dev promotion; complete12 N4>=2/4 and >= both controls plus native/source/substantive-QD and actual-prefix-difference gates precede validation.
Validation remains 60 originals (20 per C0/Q0/N4); formal remains 40 originals (10 per C0/Q0/N4/QD_OFF), with complete identity including seed block.
Protected numeric gates stay 10/20 and 5/10 with same-round controls; no new protected action-difference quota or ablation-superiority threshold.
QD_OFF means total archive removal with compatibility consumer and population Stage spread; active C0 equivalence is disclosed and the formal fourth arm is retained.
Private 240 attempts/48h, GPU3 single worker, original bucket caps, 14h/10h reservations, full 1840s window and eligible recovery maxima 4/2 are retained.
Formal candidate latch occurs before any formal reservation; report booleans alone do not provide release authority.
Production source remains mapped to selected Dev bytes; phase tooling/audit adapters require explicit reviewed allowlist and separate source freeze.
